opportunities.name: Invoice exception resolution support
opportunities.why_now: A production exception process and pipeline email-routing pattern align with the official finance modernization priority.
opportunities.decision_ask: Approve a Finance owner workshop and validate the two value assumptions before pilot funding.
opportunities.business_problem: Finance staff assemble exception context from SAP and vendor email before they can recommend a resolution or request missing information.
opportunities.agentic_enhancement: Summarize exception context, retrieve handling guidance, draft a resolution packet, and route every proposed action for human approval.

controls: Human approval before SAP or email updates
deployment.notes: The bounded design is compatible only after field-level redaction is tested.

value_case.label: medium
value_case.basis: Planning estimate; validation required for ASM-MINUTES-SAVED and ASM-LOADED-RATE.

opportunities.feasibility: Use one exception category, read-only SAP retrieval, and draft-only vendor messages before write-back.
opportunities.governance: Redact PII, retain source references, and require a Finance reviewer for every recommendation.
validation_questions: Does ASM-MINUTES-SAVED match sampled handling-time evidence?
Which Finance owner approves the pilot and ASM-LOADED-RATE?

pilot.objective: Validate resolution-packet quality and measured handling-time reduction for one invoice exception category.
pilot.narrow_scope: One SAP company code, one vendor mailbox, and draft recommendations only.
pilot.agent_role: Compile source context, retrieve guidance, and draft a resolution packet.
pilot.human_role: Review the packet and approve every SAP or vendor action.
exit_criteria: At least 90 percent packet acceptance and validated positive time savings
pilot.first_step: Sample twenty closed exceptions to validate baseline time and PII fields.
